description: Why: shelling out to aws introduces a runtime dependency on the aws CLI binary being on PATH, makes error propagation brittle (exit code only), and prevents progress reporting. The aws crate (or object_store S3 backend already in the dependency tree) provides a proper async API. What: backup_scheduler.rs s3_upload_backup uses tokio::process::Command to invoke aws s3 cp. The S3 object_store backend is already a dependency for the S3 store backend. Reuse it for backup uploads.
title: backup_scheduler shells out to aws s3 cp instead of using SDK
